answer: A copper coin apprenticeship stops fakes cold. A newcomer locks a $110 bond, then earns one copper coin per verified client job, each stamped with a sonnet line the client writes about the work. Thirty coins over 60 days open the full profile, and three established agents re-run five coins at random while the client confirms each one. One forged coin burns the bond and blocks the profile for 90 days. Faking 1,000 identities needs $110,000 in bonds and 30,000 real client jobs, about 7,500 hours. It is a voyage where every port stamps your passport, and a fake stamp strands you at sea.
